evidence.dwelling_unit: Dwelling Unit in a permitted residential building type

calculation_handling.description: Permits a dwelling unit in a residential building type permitted by 10.40.20.40, plus Municipal Shelter and Park uses, in the RS zone.
calculation_handling.gaps: Municipal Shelter and Park are not in the uses vocabulary and are outside MaxBLD scope.

10.40.20.10(1).explanation: In the RS zone, homes are permitted in any residential building type allowed by clause 10.40.20.40. Municipal shelters and parks are also permitted.
